consumer: An engine eligibility/AI/ranged check asking the yes/no 'does the avatar's eye position have unobstructed line of sight to tile T within sight range?', whose authority is the boolean the engine's LOS routine returns.
scope: A from->to reachability query between two specific tiles within a range bound (avatar eye position to the target nearby tile within sight range), not a whole-map region and not carried items.
decisive_source: src/map.cpp::map::sees(F,T,range) — computes and returns a boolean for whether F can see T within range by tracing the line and testing transparency/obstruction; its returned value is the predicate authority.
divergence: Avatar with an intervening opaque solid wall between it and a nearby, in-range tile that was previously seen: map::sees returns false (no current LOS), but a wrong answer derived from the display-observability 'seen' proxy (pl_sees, which stays true for a remembered tile) would falsely report line of sight.
